tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Architect of the Capitol shall establish in the Capitol Complex a program of public education regarding use by the Architect of the Capitol of biobased products.

tree.heading: Purposes
tree.text: The purposes of the program shall be—

children.text: to establish the Capitol Complex as a showcase for the existence and benefits of biobased products; and
to provide access to further information on biobased products to occupants and visitors.
